``preview_payout`` re-runs the exact batch logic used by the weekly payout
run, but on private copies of the hold book and rollover balances, so a
preview never releases a hold, rolls a balance forward or otherwise changes
what finance will see.

from datetime import date

    adjustments: list[Adjustment],
    period_start: date,
    period_end: date,
    holds: HoldBook,
    rollover: Rollover,
) -> tuple[str, int]:

    The values are exactly what the weekly batch would produce for this seller
    in the given period.  The preview is side-effect free: holds that would be
    released and balances that would be carried forward are applied to copies,
    so ``holds`` and ``rollover`` are left as they were.

    seller_earnings = [e for e in earnings if e.seller_id == seller.id]
    seller_adjustments = [a for a in adjustments if a.seller_id == seller.id]

        period_start,
        period_end,

        rollover=copy.deepcopy(rollover),
    )

    # The batch skipped this seller (suspended, nothing to pay, ...): report
